profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Armanino
profile.summary:
I’m a software developer based in the DFW Metroplex, currently building agentic focused tax products for Armanino. 

I hold a B.S. in Computer Science with a Cyber Security minor from Texas A&M University (along with a lifelong pain from Aggie Football). Outside of my day-to-day work, I run Wright Works, a web design and development business, and I’m actively exploring real estate and land investing.

I lead with clear communication, critical thinking, and a bias toward getting things done, whether that’s untangling a technical problem, mentoring a teammate, or building something from scratch. When I’m not coding, you’ll find me deep in fantasy football league management and research, following sports, and chasing my 2 boys around.

Let’s connect if you’re into software, real estate, fantasy football strategy, or just want to talk shop.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Completed the migration of a business-critical Angular application to modern React architecture
ahead of framework deprecation deadlines, ensuring uninterrupted application support and
usability while integrating seamlessly with existing back-end services and database systems.
• Worked with our internal component engineering team to develop reuseable React wrappers for
proprietary form components using Formik, enabling standardized state management and
accelerating adoption of React patterns across our teams.
• Later modernized and enhanced the previously mentioned wrappers and component libraries by
integrating with the latest propriety framework. Led testing, debugging, and cross-team support
efforts to ensure stability and successful implementation.
• Designed and developed comprehensive component validation pages alongside automated
Cypress test suites to verify functionality, reliability, and release readiness of our components.
• Performed extensive troubleshooting, debugging, and application level testing across client
implementations to identify edge cases, resolve integration issues, and improve our overall
developers experience while upgraded our teams applications to React.
• Collaborated across multiple teams to support department-wide modernization initiatives,
helping drive the transition toward scalable React-based technologies.
• Focused on maintaining and supported business critical production
applications by diagnosing issues across the full tech stack, ensuring system reliability.
Performed comprehensive testing, validation, and root cause analysis to protect our
applications end to end.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description: Front end React developer team lead responsible for design and development of an Electron desktop application, integrated with a .NET API to create a fully self contained application responsible for large scale data migrations with a simple and self guided user experience.

positions.title: Consultant II
positions.description:
•	Working as a hybrid external data consultant and front end developer for internal applications.
•	Leading the design and development of the refresh for one of our internal applications, taking the product from Windows Forms to modernized mock ups, to a working React/Electron prototype.
• Leading the front end React development, and assisting in the integration/development of the associated .NET API.
•	While on client work, worked with a team to transform and present data through SQL manipulation and Azure Data Factory pipelines to give the client a more beneficial understanding of the data at hand.

positions.title: Consultant I
positions.description:
• Gained experience working directly with the client to tailor our work to fit their needs.
• Worked with a high profile oil and gas customer to perform data ETLs and other SQL development tasks to better the business' understanding of the data at hand.
• Gained experience with Azure Data Factory while working to integrate data services with a public API.
• Led the pitch and design for the reboot of an internal legacy data migration tool, resulting in the decision to move forward with a complete app refactor.

positions.title: Automation Engineer I
positions.description:
• Work with the Software Automation Team to complete jobs with the end goal of automating a client’s HVAC system, specifically that of large-scale jobs such as Universities and City Governments. 
• Utilized JavaScript and Plain English to automate and graphically portray the customer’s data and building layout.
• Side project: completed a web-based contract selector tool for a Denmark based branch: https://expertteam.se.com/lokaldoa/

positions.title: Research and Development Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with R&D team to find viable solutions, to develop products for customer needs. 
• Experience with building a product from scratch, including the initial design process of applications. 
• Contributed to internal research and prototyping in .NET Core, React, and Microsoft SQL Server. 
• Assisted with building a customer’s consumer-facing React Native application from scratch, working in a fast-paced scrum framework.
